rationale: Paper 2307.14399 provides constraints on the presence and properties of atmospheric aerosols in WASP-80b, which is relevant to the question of haze. Paper 2509.23406 investigates the role of clouds in shaping the spectra of WASP-80b, contributing evidence related to atmospheric phenomena affecting transmission spectra. Both contribute to understanding discrepancies in the spectra but do not fully resolve the question.
